answer: Proof of Useful Work serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to solve verifiable computations to access the network horizon. By anchoring participation to a cryptographically secure beacon of entropy, the system ensures that identity creation incurs a measurable physical energy cost. An attacker attempting to scale fake nodes must expend proportional capital, rendering the creation of a vast, lyrical sonnet of fraudulent identities economically non-viable and computationally prohibitive.
